home.heading: Find Government Schemes Made for You.
home.subtext: Discover government benefits, check your eligibility and get step-by-step application guidance with an AI assistant that speaks your language.
home.searchLabel: Ask a question about government schemes
home.categoriesTitle: Who are you looking for schemes for?

chat.title: AI Assistant
chat.intro: Ask about government schemes in English, Hindi or Hinglish.
chat.s1: Which scholarships are there for girls in Uttarakhand?
chat.s2: What schemes are there for farmers?
chat.s3: Documents needed for Ayushman Bharat card
chat.s4: Am I eligible for any scheme?
chat.privacy: Privacy: don't share Aadhaar, bank or phone numbers. This chat is kept only in this browser tab and is sent to our server and AI provider to answer you.
chat.fallbackTitle: The AI assistant is not available right now.
chat.fallbackText: Here are schemes from our verified database that match your words:
chat.fallbackNone: No matching verified schemes were found. Try Explore Schemes.

chat.error: Your message could not be sent.
chat.rateLimited: Too many messages. Please wait a minute and retry.
chat.disclaimer: Guidance only. The final decision rests with the government authority.

elig.title: Eligibility checker
elig.intro: Answer a few questions. We only ask what the verified schemes' rules need. Your answers are not stored.
elig.notice: This is guidance only. The final decision rests with the government authority.
elig.appears_ineligible: Appears ineligible based on available criteria
elig.noRules: Detailed criteria are not encoded yet. Read the official eligibility.
elig.noSchemes: No verified schemes are available for checking yet.
elig.error: The checker could not run. Please retry.
elig.why_social_category: Asked only because some schemes (for example Stand-Up India or SC/ST scholarships) are reserved for these groups.
elig.why_minority_community: Asked only because a scholarship scheme is reserved for notified minority communities.
elig.privacy: We never ask for Aadhaar or bank details.

about.title: About Yojana Sahayak
about.p1: Yojana Sahayak helps people find government schemes, understand benefits and documents, and reach the official application page.
about.p2: It is not a government website. Information is collected by hand from official public pages and shows the date it was last checked. Always confirm on the official website before applying.
about.p3: Eligibility results come from fixed rules, not from AI. The AI assistant only explains information from our verified records.
about.dataText: Each scheme shows a badge: Live API, Retrieved public information, or Cached with its last-checked date. Draft records are never shown as fact.

footer.disclaimer: Not an official government website. Always confirm details on the official portal before applying.
footer.rights: Built for citizens, in plain language.
